cases.sentence: В те ___ Езекия заболел и был при смерти.
cases.translation: In those days Hezekiah was sick and dying.
cases.explain: The genitive case can be used to indicate time or temporal setting in certain constructions.

cases.sentence: Пророк Исаия, сын Амоца, пришел к нему и сказал, «Так говорит Господь, распорядись своим ___ ».
cases.translation: The prophet Isaiah son of Amoz came to him and said, "Thus says the Lord, put your house in order."
cases.explain: The instrumental case with the reflexive verb распорядиться (to put in order) shows the object.

cases.sentence: Езекия отвернулся лицом к стене и взмолился ___ , «Вспомни, как я ходил пред тобой».
cases.translation: Hezekiah turned his face to the wall and pleaded with the Lord, "Remember how I have walked before you."
cases.explain: The dative case with the verb взмолиться (to plead with) shows the indirect object.

cases.sentence: Прежде чем Исаия успел пройти средний двор, к нему было слово ___.
cases.translation: Before Isaiah had gone out into the middle courtyard, the word of the Lord came to him.
cases.explain: The genitive case shows possession - the word belonging to the Lord.

cases.sentence: Возвратись и скажи Езекии, вождю моего ___.
cases.translation: Return and tell Hezekiah, the leader of my people.
cases.explain: The genitive case shows possession - the people over whom Hezekiah ruled.

cases.sentence: Я услышал твою молитву и увидел твои ___.
cases.translation: I have heard your prayer and seen your tears.
cases.explain: The accusative plural is used for the direct object of the transitive verb видел.

cases.sentence: Я исцелю тебя. На третий ___ ты пойдешь в дом Господа.
cases.translation: I will heal you. On the third day you will go to the house of the Lord.
cases.explain: The accusative case shows a specific day in time without a preposition after the number.

cases.sentence: Я защищу этот ___ ради себя и ради моего слуги Давида.
cases.translation: I will protect this city for my own sake and for the sake of my servant David.
cases.explain: The accusative case is used for the direct object of the transitive verb защищу.

reading.ru: В те дни Езекия заболел и был при смерти. Пророк Исаия, сын Амоца, пришел к нему и сказал, «Так говорит Господь, распорядись своим домом, потому что ты умираешь».
reading.question: What message did Isaiah bring to Hezekiah?
options: He was going to die and should put his house in order
reading.correct: He was going to die and should put his house in order
reading.explain: Isaiah told Hezekiah that he would die and should arrange his affairs.

reading.ru: Езекия отвернулся лицом к стене и взмолился Господу, «Вспомни, о Господи, как я ходил пред тобой, в верности и от всего сердца».
reading.question: What did Hezekiah do when he heard the message?
options: He turned to the wall and prayed, reminding God of his faithfulness
He called for help from other nations
reading.correct: He turned to the wall and prayed, reminding God of his faithfulness
reading.explain: The text describes how Hezekiah turned toward the wall and pleaded with the Lord.

reading.ru: Прежде чем Исаия успел пройти средний двор, к нему было слово Господа.
reading.question: What happened immediately after Isaiah heard Hezekiah's prayer?
options: The word of the Lord came to Isaiah
A sign appeared in the sky
reading.correct: The word of the Lord came to Isaiah
reading.explain: The text states that before Isaiah had even left the courtyard, the word of the Lord came to him.

reading.ru: Возвратись и скажи Езекии, вождю моего народа. Так говорит Господь, Бог твоего предка Давида. Я услышал твою молитву и увидел твои слезы. Я исцелю тебя.
reading.question: What promise did God make to Hezekiah through Isaiah?
options: God would give him more wealth
reading.explain: The Lord promised to hear Hezekiah's prayer and tears, and said He would heal him.

reading.ru: На третий день ты пойдешь в дом Господа. Я прибавлю к твоей жизни пятнадцать лет.
reading.question: What did God add to Hezekiah's life as a sign?
reading.explain: The text clearly states that God would add fifteen years to Hezekiah's life.

reading.ru: В то время вавилонский царь Мирадах Баладан, сын Баладана, отправил Езекии письма и подарок, потому что услышал о его болезни.
reading.question: Why did the king of Babylon send gifts to Hezekiah?
options: Because he heard about his illness
reading.correct: Because he heard about his illness
reading.explain: The text states that Merodach Baladan sent letters and gifts because he had heard about Hezekiah's sickness.
